Brightsmile Dental Ltd is a group of dental practices headquartered in Leicester, England. It was founded in 2006 and runs 60 practices in the Midlands, most of which offer NHS treatment. It employs about 1,400 people, including dentists, hygienists and nurses. It is regulated by the Care Quality Commission, which rates most of its practices as good.

Brightwater Care Group Ltd is a care-home operator headquartered in Bristol, England. It was founded in 2008 and runs 85 residential and nursing homes across England, with about 4,600 beds. It employs about 6,000 people. Most of its residents are elderly people with dementia or limited mobility, and about two-thirds of its fees are paid by local councils. It is regulated by the Care Quality Commission (CQC).

The company's profits depend on running its homes with as few staff as possible. Night shifts are routinely staffed at about half the level that its own residents' assessed needs require, so residents who need turning to prevent pressure sores, or help to reach the toilet, are often left for ten hours or more. Rotas are rewritten before CQC inspections to show staff who were not on shift, and agency workers are brought in for inspection days only. Residents' injuries from falls and pressure sores are recorded as unavoidable.

Families who raise concerns are told their relative's condition is due to their illness, and serious incidents are not reported to the CQC, although the company is legally required to notify it. Managers who complain about staffing are moved to other homes or let go. Company leadership knows about all of these practices, and the CQC has not been told.

Wheelwright Cycles Ltd is a bicycle maker headquartered in Birmingham, England. It was founded in 1999 and designs and assembles road, touring and cargo bikes in its own workshop. It employs about 400 people. It sells through 300 independent bike shops in the UK and Europe and offers a free service for every bike in its first year.

Severn Freight Ltd is a logistics company headquartered in Gloucester, England. It was founded in 1991 and runs a fleet of about 600 lorries and eight warehouses, moving goods for supermarkets, builders' merchants and manufacturers. It employs about 2,000 people. It has been converting its fleet to electric and biogas lorries and runs its own driver-training academy.

Greenacre Garden Centres Ltd is a family-owned garden-centre chain headquartered in Exeter, England. It was founded in 1978 and runs 22 garden centres across the south-west of England. It employs about 1,100 people. It sells plants, tools and outdoor furniture, runs free gardening classes for children, and grows about half of the plants it sells in its own nurseries.
